notes: Open-weight decision models: no vendor price. billing_basis self_host; cost per decision is a function of your GPU/CPU cost, utilization, state length and question packing (see local CPU measurements for scale). License strings are the Hugging Face cardData field and not verified against LICENSE files; JPT is CC-BY-NC-4.0 (non-commercial). The independent JevBench board prices self-hosted rows from a base-model reference, not from tariffs (see the JevBench doc).

clef.notes: Open weights, license Apache-2.0: no license fee; cost is hardware and serving only (not computed here). Hardware reality: see capability and caveat notes (e.g. Clef 27B needs about 54 GB VRAM in bf16 per an independent report; community GGUF quants of Clef cover only the language backbone).
